business_summary: AXA is a France-listed (Euronext Paris: CS) global multiline insurer spanning property and casualty, life and health, and asset management. Its AXA XL specialty division underwrites upstream energy property insurance, including physical damage, business interruption and control-of-well cover, on fixed and floating offshore installations.

exposure_summary.narrative: AXA's sole offshore-counter-drone placement is offshore-war-and-property-underwriting (QUIET, impact 55/crowdedness 25): plausible money at stake and nobody watching yet, but the chain's own map_limitation states plainly that no source fetched in this build prices war or property cover on a fixed Black Sea offshore installation specifically, so the repricing this link would carry is a stated hypothesis on the chain, not a sized number. AXA XL's upstream energy book is, in any case, a small fraction of a global multiline insurer whose FY2025 revenue was 105.9bn EUR; no exposure percentage is disclosed.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: no revenue percentage tied to the offshore-war-and-property-underwriting exposure, or to AXA XL's upstream energy line specifically, is sourced for AXA this run. See data_gaps.

latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 105,925,000,000 EUR from the yfinance-statements statements in CS-PA.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (105,925,000,000/81,461,000,000)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 9,046,000,000 EUR divided by revenue 97,671,000,000 EUR, both for the period ended 2023-12-31, the most recent fiscal year for which operating_income_fy has an entry in the yfinance-statements block (the series stops at 2023-12-31; no 2024 or 2025 operating-income line item is present for this insurer). Computed on the matched FY2023 pair rather than mixed periods; not the FY2025 revenue figure above.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 22,352,000,000 EUR divided by net income 9,797,000,000 EUR, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 22,352,000,000 EUR less capex 428,000,000 EUR, divided by revenue 105,925,000,000 EUR, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: No fiscal year has both operating_income_fy and depreciation_fy in the CS-PA.json vendor block: operating_income_fy stops at 2023-12-31 and depreciation_fy only starts at 2024-12-31, so an EBITDA proxy cannot be computed from an overlapping year. Net debt-to-EBITDA is in any case not a standard leverage read for a multiline insurer's balance sheet.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score PENDING_DATA in CS-PA.json quality.piotroski: missing current_assets_fy, current_liabilities_fy and cost_of_revenue_fy inputs (6 of 9 inputs found); insurer balance-sheet items the vendor's generic mapping does not carry.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score PENDING_DATA in CS-PA.json quality.beneish: missing cost_of_revenue_fy, current_assets_fy and current_liabilities_fy inputs (9 of 12 inputs found).

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 93,337,853,952 EUR computed in CS-PA.json quality.derived.market_cap from vendor/official share count and price (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals).

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 93,337,853,952 EUR divided by revenue 105,925,000,000 EUR for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 131,580,853,952 EUR implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 21,924,000,000 EUR, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over yfinance-statements statements. The solve is negative: the market is pricing FCF decline from this base, not growth. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon (5y -18.35%, 7y -14.08%, 10y -10.85%). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement; the sign (decline priced in) is stable across all three horizons.

crowdedness_caveats: AXA's sole offshore-counter-drone link (offshore-war-and-property-underwriting) is QUIET (impact 55/crowdedness 25); the chain's own map_limitation states no source fetched in this build prices Black Sea offshore war or property cover specifically, so the money this link would reprice is a stated hypothesis, not a sized number.
